name: skill-library-pruner
title_zh: 先盘点后动手的技能库瘦身师，删前必问三遍
tagline_zh: 技能多到找不到北？它先列全清单、标出零使用和重复项，再让你逐个确认。不点头的绝不删，删完还能反悔。
tagline_en: Too many skills? It inventories all, flags unused & duplicates, then asks before each delete. Nothing vanishes.
desc_en: Read-first, reversible workflow for pruning an overgrown Claude Code skills library. Inventories every skill, spots duplicates and dead weight, reports what has not been used, disables safely, then deletes only what goes unmissed. Use when the user wants to prune, declutter, audit, consolidate, or shrink their skills, or says "I have too many skills", "clean up my skills", "which of my skills are
why_zh: 别的清理工具上来就删，它先建只读清单，把「禁用」和「删除」分成两步——先安全关掉，等你确认真不怀念。
why_en: Unlike delete-first tools, it separates disabling from deleting: quarantine first, confirm you don't miss it, then purge.
limit_zh: 只认 Claude Code 的 skills 目录结构；不碰全局配置或非本项目的技能。
limit_en: Only handles Claude Code's skills folder; ignores global config or non-project skills. Outputs report + disable/delete actions; no backup—ensure.
title_en: Skill-library pruner that inventories before it deletes
